findings.dataset: EEGMMIDB1.0.0:64 EEG channels,160Hz,EDF+,109 subject IDs documented by MNE,14 runs. Dataset index reports3.4GB uncompressed/1.9GB ZIP. No raw files downloaded or file checksums certified.
findings.mne: Published example uses subject1 and runs6/10/14 imagined hands/feet, post-cue1–2s features,7–30Hz zero-phase noncausal FIR,CSP4+LDA Pipeline,trial-level ShuffleSplit10,test_size.2,random_state103. Not cross-subject/run/session or pre-decision prediction; not executed here. Full-data CSP fit for visualization must not enter held-out scoring.
findings.readiness: Movement-locked averages and awareness-clock reports are different measurements from cued motor imagery. EEGMMIDB does not supply the Libet awareness-clock protocol. Schurger2012 offers an accumulator/selection interpretation of average RP; this does not certify single-trial intention decoding.
findings.fmri: Soon2008 indexed abstract reports information before reported awareness in a constrained experiment. Full publisher methods/supplement unavailable in this audit. No exact classifier,split,lead time,accuracy or dataset replication certified.
findings.rights: PhysioNet database ODC-By1.0 requires attribution; it does not license individual contents or waive privacy/personality rights. Detailed original consent/IRB/participant-use restrictions not inspected. No raw data or copyrighted bodies/figures/code redistributed.

recommendation.name: Offline Trial-Window Feature Classification and Leakage Diagnostics — Synthetic Reference Scope
recommendation.supported_candidate: Self-authored synthetic rational windows or declared feature tables; exact mean/population variance; binary unscaled uniform-prior nearest arithmetic centroid; train-only fit; named class-A tie; confusion,accuracy,fixed-class balanced accuracy and train-majority baseline on matched test IDs.
recommendation.scientific_limit: Editorial mathematical reference only: not CSP/LDA replication, band-specific neural features, empirical decoding, mind reading, free-will adjudication or a live BCI.
experimental: Later rights-cleared offline EEG replication with frozen file manifest and numerical preprocessing recipe
Behavioral proxy explicitly labeled non-neural and task-specific
unsupported: Unrestricted future decisions or covert intentions

required_contract: Freeze subject_disjoint protocol OR within_subject_heldout_run protocol; do not rename runs as sessions. Verify session metadata before session-level claims.
Fixed train/validation/test identities before feature selection or tuning. Fit centroids,scaling,CSP and every learned transform on train only. Test labels may score,never fit or select predictions.

Keep all dependent windows from one trial and overlapping source intervals in one partition; verify source-file/trial/group identity,not just duplicate feature values. Numeric duplicates may occur legitimately.
Declare channel order,units,reference,sampling rate,task/run family,window half-open bounds,event origin and feature availability. Prohibit post-outcome information for a pre-outcome claim.
A zero-phase/noncausal filter cannot support online pre-decision availability claims; freeze filtering boundaries and train/test contamination controls.
T1/T2 semantics are run-dependent. Do not pool executed/imagined/rest or hands/feet versus left/right tasks.

Matched eligible IDs and denominators for model/baseline; train-majority tie goes to canonical A. Test prevalence is descriptive only. Missing true class makes fixed-binary balanced accuracy not_estimable,not perfect.
Chance .5 is a declared balanced iid binary null,not universal EEG chance. Correlation,selection and multiplicity invalidate naive binomial claims; toy p-values certify only arithmetic.
Provenance requires dataset DOI/version,exact file hashes,rights/consent review,channel/run/window manifest and split hashes before empirical work.

proposed_limits.status: Unmeasured proposals; freeze and benchmark before implementation acceptance.
proposed_limits.note: Combined caps govern; maxima cannot all be combined. Exact arithmetic bit growth needs pre-operation reservation. No new dependencies proposed.

anchor_scope: Fraction/math.comb arithmetic only; no neural model or benchmark executed. Variance denominator n; squared distances exact; confusion rows actual,columns predicted. Tie A. 7/128 toy tail is not empirical significance.
